title: Pre-Analysis — Data Loader Interface Standard B with Solid State Media

ata.title: Data Loading — Portable Data Loader Interface

abstract: Re-analysis of the standard B data loader interface opened when the third standard entered design, covering the prerequisite chain, the bulletin kit and the configuration reporting the maintenance system now depends on.

sections.objective: The standard B conversion has been in service for four years and a third standard is now in design. The round was opened to establish what the second standard has become load bearing for, so that the third standard does not silently remove something the maintenance organisation now relies on.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed. The first is the prerequisite chain: standard B assumes the extended temperature transceiver is already fitted, and a third standard that skips that assumption would inherit the temperature limitation from the rack cooling arrangement rather than from the unit. The second is the conversion bulletin, whose kit contains the air baffle that made the cooling independent of the blanking plate; that baffle is now the only thing keeping the rack thermally correct and it must be carried forward. The third is the candidate third standard itself, which shares the rack position and the internal harness clamps, and whose signed verification changes what the configuration report contains. The maintenance organisation has built its configuration dispute process on that report, which nobody outside publications had recorded.
sections.next_steps: Carry the air baffle forward into the third standard kit explicitly rather than by assumption. Record the configuration report content as a maintenance interface so that the third standard cannot change it silently. Pass both points into the third standard's own review.

similarity_seeds: configuration report written to the maintenance system after a software load

expected_findings.rationale: Standard B assumes the extended temperature transceiver is already fitted. A later standard that skips the assumption inherits the temperature limitation from the rack rather than from the unit.
expected_findings.resolution: State the prerequisite explicitly in the third standard rather than relying on the population being converted.

expected_findings.rationale: The conversion kit contains the air baffle that made the rack cooling independent of the blanking plate. That baffle is now the only thing keeping the rack thermally correct.
expected_findings.resolution: Carry the air baffle forward into the third standard kit explicitly.

expected_findings.rationale: The candidate third standard shares the rack position and the harness clamps, and its signed verification changes what the configuration report contains. The maintenance organisation has built its dispute process on that report.
expected_findings.resolution: Record the configuration report content as a maintenance interface and pass it into the third standard review.

expected_non_findings.reason: Surfaced by the shared vocabulary of software loading and part number verification, but it is a flight management computer load and it neither uses the data loader interface rack nor writes to the configuration report.

type_data.conclusion: Closed with two interfaces recorded that had never been written down. The value of the round was in what it caught rather than in what it changed.
